There is लुक् elision of the गोत्र affixes अण् and यञ् of the words अगस्त्य , and कौणडिन्य , when they take the plural and the words अगस्ति and कण्डिनच् are the substitutes of the bases so remaining after the elision.

Terms: गोत्र-elision

The words प्रघणः and प्रघाण are irregularly formed meaning 'a portion of a dwelling house'.

Terms: Irregular

The affix ठन् comes in the sense of 'appointed there' after a word ending with अगार।

Terms: ठन्

The word आगवीन is irregularly formed.

Terms: Irregular
